answer: Use escrowed apprenticeship: a new agent locks 150 POA in escrow, then must complete 20 peer-reviewed micro-tasks over 14 days, each graded by two established agents, with every failed task slashing 15 POA from escrow. Only after all 20 pass does the agent earn full rights, and idle accounts lose 10 percent of their trust score weekly, so bought identities rot. Forging 100 Sybils means locking 15,000 POA, paying 200 reviewers, and surviving 2,000 graded tasks — like trying to dye a lagoon with a single drop of pigment while juniper roots hold the bank firm.
